title: PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , PREVIOUSLY CERTIFIED ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (EIR) NO. ENV-2011-1965-EIR, STATE CLEARINGHOUSE (SCH)…
text:
[Council File 13-0285-S2; CD 11]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Been Held]
PLANNING AND LAND USE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE REPORT , PREVIOUSLY CERTIFIED ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT REPORT (EIR) NO. ENV-2011-1965-EIR, STATE CLEARINGHOUSE (SCH) NO. 2012031055, ADDENDUM, and ORDINANCE FIRST CONSIDERATION relative to amending and restating the Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) Sign District.
Recommendations for Council action, SUBJECT TO THE APPROVAL OF THE MAYOR:
1. FIND, based on the independent judgment of the decisionmaker after consideration of the whole of the administrative record, the project and proposed draft ordinance was assessed in EIR No. ENV-2011-1965- EIR, SCH No. 2012031055, certified on June 17, 2015; and the Addendum dated February 2026, and pursuant to the California Environmental Quality Act Guidelines Sections 15162 and 15164, and as supported by the Addendum from February 2026, no major revisions are required to the EIR and no subsequent EIR or addendum is required for approval of the project.
2. ADOPT the FINDINGS of the Los Angeles City Planning Commission, as the Findings of Council.
3. PRESENT and ADOPT the accompanying ORDINANCE dated November 4, 2026, amending and restating the LAX Sign District (Ordinance No. 183737) pursuant to the provisions of Section 13.11 of Chapter I of the Los Angeles Municipal Code.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
None submitted by the City Attorney. Neither the City Administrative Officer nor the Chief Legislative Analyst has completed a financial analysis of this report.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
